title: Cozy Comfy +
description: A hand-picked collection of cozy mods to make your world softer. Simple, aesthetic, and kitchen sink-free!
body:
![Cozy Comfy Plus, logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9c0d3b348c9cc1773d55590a4328fad565f3cf7.png)

### Enhance your vanilla Minecraft experience
**..with a blend of cozy, user-friendly mods that add aesthetic and simple functional enhancements :D**

Let's be honest. We all know the cycle: start a server, build a dirt hut, get iron armor, get bored, and quit after two weeks.

**Cozy Comfy+** was built to break that cycle !

## Why making Cozy Comfy?

I didn't just throw random mods into a folder. I hand-picked every single one to create the perfect bridge between a relaxing building simulator and a genuine adventure. Whether you want to spend 50 hours designing a kitchen or exploring dangerous frozen caves, this pack respects your time and your PC. And with a lot of QoL mods to enhance your experience.

## Mods

Find mods like **CliffTree** and **Cinderscapes** for world generation, **Create** and **Tom's Simple Storage** for technology/nerds, **Farmer's Delight** for farming, **Iris** & **Sodium** for optimization and shaders, **Animal Garden** mods for new animals, utility mods like **Bridging Mod**, Social mods like **Camerapture** and **Simple Voice Chat**, Exploration mods like **End Remastered**, **Towns and Towers**, and collectibles with following mods: **Collectors Album**, **More Music Discs** ! (and many other cozy related mods, especially decoration mods)

And don't forgot the backpacks with **Traveler's Backpack** :3

A lot of performances mods like **Sodium or Ferrite Core** will help every player of your Minecraft squad playing with you with less lag/fps issues.

## Join the Community

We are actively updating the pack and listening to feedback. If you have a suggestion, a bug report, or just want to share screenshots of your base, jump on our [Discord](https://discord.gg/E6mkRHB8Am)!
